title: batch-4 per-model outcomes that T1 writes for T2 (fixed at P1)
description: docs/plans/B4_INTEGRATION.md D5, D12. scripts/t1_scoreboard.py writes this object under the key 'model_outcomes' of every FIT-layout scoreboard.json (results/b4_t1/<id>_fit<tag>/scoreboard.json), for the D, N, Dnew units in discovery and the C, K, F, F20 units in confirmation. scripts/collapse_laws.js reads O1 and O5 from it for the PRIMARY (the owner's hypothesis) and never recomputes them. T2 alone computes the accuracy and head coordinates of the laws. Every number is a value from the stored float32 logits and the batch-4 dumps (atlas/b4_core.open_dump); a non-finite value is written as null.

O1.description: dAUC_joint on clean errors: AUROC(head summary + penult bundle) - AUROC(head summary), cross-fitted on the same folds by atlas/b4_core.head_increment (ridge-logistic on restricted cubic splines, 5 group folds by image row), target = argmax != label on fit-layout clean test rows 0-4999, groups = image rows. Head summary = T1's full head summary (sorted logits linear; gap, max logit, energy, entropy as splines). CI = the 95% group-bootstrap percentile interval (B = 200 discovery, 1000 confirmation). 'call' = atlas/b4_core.head_additive_call.

O5.description: X4 flag AUROC - best head AUROC at severity 3: positives corrupt__<c>__s3 (CIFAR-10-C rows 0-1999, paired with clean rows 0-1999) for each of the 10 discovery corruptions, negatives the clean test rows 3500-4999 (B); X4 = the fused conformal p-value of the calibrated multi-tap flag (conformal p per tap from atlas/b4_core.conformal_p calibrated on A1 = rows 2000-2749, fusion calibrated on A2 = rows 2750-3499), scored as -p; head statistics msp, maxlogit, gap, energy, entropy oriented by atlas/b4_core.ERR_SIGN. value = mean over the 10 corruptions of AUROC(X4) - mean AUROC of the best head statistic, the best being the head statistic with the largest mean AUROC over the same 10 corruptions (a choice that favours the head).
